rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for obtaining money or property through threats or force.

example.english: Someone held a knife to my brother and committed extortion, forcing him to hand over all his money.
example.traditional: 有人用刀指住我阿哥勒索佢，逼佢交晒啲錢出嚟。
